_what: Recorded `gh pr list --state open --limit 400 --json number,headRefName,createdAt,isDraft,labels,mergeStateStatus` output, plus constructed rows for the cases a live queue does not happen to contain. Every row says which it is.
_why: B1's evidence is the live queue, and an `Acceptance:` command may never use `gh` -- the acceptance job runs author-written commands under read-only, tracker-less credentials, always. So the decision proves itself against this fixture in CI, and the live run is pasted on the row as evidence with a clock. A fixture also holds the cases that MATTER: the live queue tonight held two PRs, neither four hours old, so a live run could not exercise a single closure.
